scope: Official KEPCO, KPX, K-water, and Incheon Waterworks electricity/water artifacts collected for the I5 hackathon

raw/utilities/incheon_water_billed_usage.grain: pre-2026 district or waterworks-office x annual billed usage

raw/utilities/kepco_eds_openapi_services.warning: Service names do not grant public access to citywide customer records. Customer authorization and KEPCO terms require separate confirmation.

raw/utilities/kepco_hourly_power_by_regi.grain: KEPCO regional headquarters x date x hour
raw/utilities/kepco_hourly_power_by_regi.warning: Provider states remote-meter collected totals can differ from official total statistics. KEPCO headquarters geography is not assumed identical to administrative Incheon.

raw/utilities/kepco_legal_dong_power_202.validation_failure: 15104908 metadata declares industry classification and sales fields, but the downloaded file has only 시도/시군구/법정동/년도/월/전체호수/전력사용량. The suppression token '5호미만제거' and schema match data.go.kr 15111712 net-metering customer data semantics. It must not be treated as total legal-dong household electricity.

raw/utilities/kepco_low_voltage_outage_b.grain: sample branch x annual outage cause counts
raw/utilities/kepco_low_voltage_outage_b.warning: Full data is available only through KEPCO data safe zones in Seoul or Naju.

raw/utilities/kpx_admin_area_energy_use_.grain: province x month x energy category x use category

raw/utilities/kwater_jeongeup_anonymized.preprocessing_policy: Difference consecutive valid cumulative-looking readings; preserve missing flags; treat negative differences as reset/replacement/data-quality candidates rather than consumption.

raw/utilities/kwater_national_water_mete.warning: Total water meters are not the count of smart or remotely readable meters.

kepco_household_average_15101404.access: KEPCO electricity-data portal membership; development auto approval; production review
kepco_household_average_15101404.granularity: household average, not identified household AMI

kwater_realtime_facility_apis.access: data.go.kr serviceKey; development and production auto approval; development traffic 10000
kwater_realtime_facility_apis.granularity: water intake/treatment/booster/reservoir facility x hour, not household meter
kwater_realtime_facility_apis.mvp_role: optional network-event context after key and facility coverage verification

required_ui_labels: 정읍 공개표본 기반 시뮬레이션 · 인천 실측 아님
공개 집계로 검토 우선 지역을 좁힘
prohibited_claims: Open data identifies Incheon households or persons in danger
Zero utility use proves solitary death or depression
The Jeongeup smart-meter sample is Incheon data
The mismatched legal-dong file is total household electricity
Annual outage aggregates provide realtime outage suppression

recommended_mvp.real_incheon_layer: Use only aggregate neighborhood/city context and the existing care-priority map; no household markers.
recommended_mvp.ai_demo_layer: Run a cumulative-reading difference and sustained-deviation detector on the anonymized Jeongeup sample with explicit DEMO labeling.
recommended_mvp.real_pilot_path: Seek an opt-in or municipality-internal pilot with Incheon Waterworks remote meter users; keep raw readings inside the data controller boundary and use human confirmation before outreach.
recommended_mvp.electricity_pilot_path: Treat KEPCO EDS/i-Smart 15-minute integration as a second-stage customer-authorized partnership, not an available hackathon feed.

warnings: A public-file license does not authorize access to non-public identified customer readings.
Legal dong, administrative dong, KEPCO headquarters, current districts, and pre-reorganization districts are different spatial grains.
The 2023 Incheon press release's meter counts conflict in scale with the 2024 national meter-status file; use the release only as evidence that an operational remote-reading program exists.
This validation is implementation guidance and not legal advice.
